turns.q: My order arrived and one item is damaged, what do I do?
turns.replyTail:
LCOME TO NAKED WARDROBE. I’M HERE TO HELP YOU FIND THE PERFECT FIT OR ANSWER ANY QUESTIONS.
MY ORDER ARRIVED AND ONE ITEM IS DAMAGED, WHAT DO I DO?
I’m sorry one of your items arrived damaged. Please start a request through our RETURN PORTAL, select the reason that matches the damage, and include a brief description, a photo of the item, and a photo of the care tag inside the garment. Our team will review the request and, if approved, email you a prepaid return label.
